$comment: Single source of truth for how every distribution channel describes kya, and for the screenshots they show. Edit here, then run `pnpm sync:channel-copy`; `pnpm check:channel-copy` (CI) fails on any drift. Every variant starts with the tagline. Keep it truthful: local OSS is advisory and fails open except the never-list; never claim OSS enforcement or call the hosted console GA.
short: Audit trail and traceability for AI agents.
long: Audit trail and traceability for AI agents. See what every coding agent did, block risky calls, ask a human for approval, and prove it with signed trust checks.

variants.mcp: Audit trail and traceability for AI agents. MCP gate: evaluate, ingest, request approval.
variants.plugin: Audit trail and traceability for AI agents. See what every coding agent did. Advisory: records every tool call, blocks only the never-list, fails open.
variants.python: Audit trail and traceability for AI agents. In-process kya shim for Python agent frameworks (offline evaluate via the kya CLI).
variants.webInstall: Audit trail and traceability for AI agents. Install in minutes: offline demo, MCP gate, local free console, or hosted. No private protocol.
variants.webHowKyaWorks: Audit trail and traceability for AI agents. Register an agent, wrap a tool, get Allow, Hold, or Deny. What to do after a local or company install.

screenshots.alt: Activity receipt - one recorded agent tool call with its verdict and evidence
Activity tab - filterable agent tool-call feed with verdicts
Certify tab - full Agent Trust Baseline requirement table with evidence
Changes tab - what actually changed per session: files touched with redacted diff previews
Gateway backends - MCP servers the local gate routes to
Gateway listeners - local MCP gate endpoints
Gateway playground - dry-run a tool call against the local policy
Gateway policies - local gate policy rules
Gateway routes - which tools route to which backend
Gateway section - local MCP gate with listeners, routes, backends, policies, and a dry-run playground
KYA report - live dashboard: Certify trust baseline, verdicts, analytics
